reviewed: 26.3 removed block codecs entirely: Block/BlockBehaviour have no codec() to override and vanilla blocks (EnchantingTableBlock) carry no CODEC, so there is nothing to port (it only served the 1.20.5-26.2 block-type registry). getLightBlock and onRemove are ported as in the parents: getLightDampening(BlockState) returns 0; onRemove's drop is BlockEntity.preRemoveSideEffects (the BE is a Container) and its comparator update is affectNeighborsAfterRemoval -> Containers.updateNeighboursAfterDestroy.

reviewed: (inherited from 26.1.2) Ported: GeckoLib 5.5 BlockAndItemGeoLayer -- context constructor; getRelevantBones(entity, ...) resolves each hand bone's stack with the per-stack display context (shield NONE, else third-person right/left), published in addRenderData beside the archer flag; getStackForBone/getTransformTypeForStack now take the bone name (5.5 has no such hooks, the item is resolved at extraction); the @Override submitItemStackRender(PoseStack, GeoBone, ItemStackRenderState, ItemDisplayContext, R, SubmitNodeCollector, int) keeps the pivot transform, shield pose and archer/forward offsets, then super.
